description: Check whether one SaaS or cloud vendor (e.g. Stripe) is down right now: current status, confidence, active incidents, 30-day uptime and how fresh the data is, read live from PulseWatch. Use it for one vendor. Call list_vendors (free) first if you are not sure the vendor is tracked: unknown vendors return an error and are not charged. Read-only. Costs $0.01 USDC per call via x402 (payment goes in _meta["x402/payment"]); invalid input or an upstream failure is not charged.

vendor.description: Vendor name, slug or domain, e.g. 'Stripe', 'stripe' or stripe.com
